name: trinket-pm2
description: Locks the pm2 process-manager tree that the root image's CMD (pm2-docker start app.js) invokes; it is not part of the application's dependency graph and is never published. The js-yaml override lifts pm2's transitive ~4.1.0 range past the 4.x quadratic-CPU advisories (fixed in 4.3.1) to the same 4.3.2 the application resolves, so the shipped image carries no high-severity advisory outside the one the plan approves.
